text: Minimum equipment protection: zone 1 Ex d, Ex e, Ex p or Ex ia / ib; zone 2 Ex n / ec or better; zone 0 Ex ia only. Gas group IIB + H2 and temperature class T3 as the minimum for all classified areas (covers natural gas with the hydrogen admixture capability of DP-CASE-0021, LDO vapour and ammonia); group IIC in hydrogen areas (generators, hydrogen supply, battery rooms if classified), where T1 is sufficient. The classification report shall state the group and class per area; a lower group is not permitted without a recorded reason.
